reviewContext.issueReference: workflow-input:inline (issueTitle 'Dashboard: dark flat theme, foldable panes, active range buttons, effort grouping, distinct model colors'; no GitHub issue URL or number; plan review communication comm-002501)
reviewContext.userProblem: The dashboard uses a light-first rounded theme whose dark variant hides the active range preset (dark override selector specificity 0,3,1 beats .range-buttons button.active 0,2,1). The left pane and responsive header cannot fold. The chart stacks by model only and cannot separate reasoning effort. Hash-based model colors collide or look near-identical (for example the sol and luna models).
requiredOutcomes: Dark-only base theme on every surface, chart, form control, and the machine admin panel, with WCAG contrast targets (text >= 4.5:1; muted text, interactive control borders, chart axis >= 3:1).
Flat square design: no non-zero border-radius, no shadows, gradients, or drop-shadow filters; chart bar and tooltip rects use rx=0; square legend swatches.
Square buttons with hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, and aria-pressed=true pressed states through a single .toggle-group button[aria-pressed="true"] rule.

Left filter pane folds horizontally to a rail above 980px and vertically to a bar at 980px and below; the stacked header (1180px and below) folds vertically; fold state persists as sidebarCollapsed and headerCollapsed.
Range preset buttons show the pressed state from the range() signal, including after restore; Custom is pressed only when range is custom.

Opt-in modelEffort stack mode ('Model + effort'): Codex turn_context effort parsed in Swift, carried through reconciliation, merge keys, the session_metrics cache column, and GET /api/cost-series?effortBreakdown=true, rendered with an explicit unknown bucket.

Collision-free model colors from vendor hue families (anthropic warm, openai green/teal/blue, other violet/magenta) with effort shades of the model color, covered by computed deltaE and contrast tests.
App.tsx split by responsibility (UsageChart, RangeControls, DashboardLayout modules) and ends below 1580 lines.
Bundled web assets under Sources/AppCore/Resources/Web regenerated last by mise run frontend:build.
mise run test, mise run lint, mise run frontend:test, and mise run frontend:check pass.

Responses without effortBreakdown are identical to pre-change responses.

Workers share one working tree on main with no git mutations (no commit, stash, checkout, reset, restore, clean, branches, or worktrees).
No emojis in code, docs, or commit messages; no AI attribution in commit messages.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Dark-only theme with CSS custom properties on :root; light theme removed to avoid doubling the flat restyle surface (user-QA default 1, reversible).
Pressed state uses aria-pressed and one shared selector so no group rule can hide it; this fixes the specificity root cause of the range bug.
Fold state persisted server-side in DashboardUIState (decodeIfPresent, default false, always encoded); CSS alone decides fold effect per breakpoint and collapsed content stays mounted.
Effort follows model per Codex turn_context (not directory); a turn_context without effort resets to nil; forward, reverse, and resume scans must agree.
UsageEffort.normalized trims, lowercases, accepts ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$, else nil; effort never affects event identity.
Session reconciliation bucket, SessionCoalesceKey, and SessionRowKey include effort so effort rows neither collapse nor replace each other; per-model totals unchanged.

session_metrics gains effort TEXT; for the local machine only, the migration clears directory_coverage_ranges in the same transaction so the existing backfill re-derives effort; SSH caches keep coverage.
effortBreakdown parsing reuses dashboardDirectoryRequest with a distinct invalid_breakdown error; shared error mapping keeps MachineDashboardRouter.swift under 1000 lines.
Model colors: vendor classification from name, sorted-catalog linear-probing allocation, overrides do not consume slots, effort shades by HSL lightness offsets, unknown desaturated.
Plans run in four waves with disjoint per-wave writePaths; EDF-12 serially reconciles DRIFT and BLOCKED-BY-FOREIGN entries.
intentionalTradeoffs: Model colors depend on the model catalog: stable for a fixed catalog, contested slots may move when models are added or removed (documented in seriesColors.ts).
Past vendor family capacity, colors are reused in probe order rather than erroring.
One-time local provenance backfill on first launch after upgrade, same cost as the earlier directory migration.
Effort splits sub-daily session buckets into more rows in memory and cache; non-breakdown responses collapse them so payload size is unchanged.
App.tsx typecheck may fail in waves 1-2 until EDF-11 rewires it; wave 1-2 frontend plans only require no errors in their own files.
Removing the light theme is a visible change recorded as a reversible default.
supportedEdgeCases: Legacy persisted dashboard state without stackBy or fold keys restores to model and expanded.
Unknown stackBy values coerce to model.
Non-string Codex effort values (number, object, array) decode as nil without dropping the turn_context or its model.
Mid-session effort changes and turns without effort; resume after appended lines keeps the last turn's effort.
Claude, SSH-machine, ccusage aggregate, and log-less historical rows carry nil effort and render as '<model> (unknown)'.
Legacy SQLite cache without the effort column: local cache clears provenance coverage once; SSH cache preserves it; second open does not clear again.
effortBreakdown duplicate item, invalid value, or use on non-cost-series routes returns 400 invalid_breakdown; directoryBreakdown errors keep invalid_directory.
effortBreakdown composes with directory filters and directoryBreakdown.
Custom editor opened while a preset is applied does not press Custom; Custom exposes aria-expanded.
Collapsing the header while the custom-range editor is open hides the editor without applying or discarding its draft.
Header fold toggle hidden above 1180px; header always expanded there regardless of stored value.
Color overrides from /api/chart-colors dark.models and dark.machines still win.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Light-theme users and chartColors.light overrides (config stays valid, SPA ignores it).
Effort for remote SSH machines or ccusage-only data.
Deterministic ordering of rows that differ only in effort at the same timestamp and model when effortBreakdown=true (frontend does not depend on row order; tests compare order-insensitively).
ICU localeCompare legend-order differences versus code-unit sort for mixed-case or control-character identities in non-modelEffort modes.
residualRisksFromReview: EDF-04: tests/api.test.ts has no existing cost-series cases; use the getJSON/requestJSON fetch-stub pattern near api.test.ts:74 as the template.
EDF-10: compareSeriesIdentities localeCompare may differ from code-unit sort for unusual identities; existing tests are the guard.
EDF-08: collapsedSessions dictionary order may make effort-distinct rows order nondeterministic; compare order-insensitively.
